entries.name: SHOPIFY_SHOP_DOMAIN
howToGet: In Shopify admin, go to Settings > Domains and copy the myshopify.com domain.

entries.name: SHOPIFY_CLIENT_ID
entries.description: Client ID of the store's Dev Dashboard app. With SHOPIFY_CLIENT_SECRET, the connector requests a 24-hour Admin API token and renews it itself.
howToGet: Sign in to the Shopify Dev Dashboard as the store owner, so the app and the store share an organization.

Create an app, and in its version grant only these Admin API scopes: read_orders, read_all_orders, read_products, read_customers and read_inventory. Without read_all_orders Shopify returns only the last 60 days of orders. No write scopes.
Release the version, install the app on the store, then copy the Client ID from the app's Settings.

entries.name: SHOPIFY_CLIENT_SECRET
entries.description: Client secret of the store's Dev Dashboard app, used only to request Admin API tokens. It also signs webhooks, so set SHOPIFY_WEBHOOK_SECRET to the same value.
howToGet: In the Shopify Dev Dashboard, open the app's Settings and copy the Client secret straight into the host's secret store.

entries.name: SHOPIFY_ADMIN_ACCESS_TOKEN
entries.description: Permanent Admin API token of an older custom app made in the store admin. Use it instead of SHOPIFY_CLIENT_ID and SHOPIFY_CLIENT_SECRET only when the store already has such an app.
howToGet: Shopify stopped letting merchants create these apps on 2026-01-01; new stores use SHOPIFY_CLIENT_ID and SHOPIFY_CLIENT_SECRET.

For an existing app, in Shopify admin go to Settings > Apps and sales channels > Develop apps, check it holds only read_orders, read_all_orders, read_products, read_customers and read_inventory, and copy its Admin API access token.

entries.name: SHOPIFY_API_VERSION
entries.description: Shopify Admin API version the connector pins, e.g. 2026-07. Defaults to the version the connector was tested with.
howToGet: Leave empty to use the tested default. Shopify supports each quarterly version for 12 months; move up when the vendor docs watch reports a change.

entries.name: SHOPIFY_WEBHOOK_SECRET
entries.description: The Shopify app's client secret, which signs webhook deliveries (X-Shopify-Hmac-SHA256). Only needed when webhooks are turned on.
howToGet: For a Dev Dashboard app, use the same value as SHOPIFY_CLIENT_SECRET.
For an older admin-made app, open its API credentials under Settings > Apps and sales channels > Develop apps and copy the API secret key.
